claim: Claim 2 measuring-instrument competence gate; tests the model, not Prefixity

model.label: lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
model.quantizer: LM Studio team using llama.cpp release b8185
model.loading: direct frozen file via -m with --offline; -hf is forbidden

reasoning_mechanism.source_evidence: b10217 common/arg.cpp: --reasoning off sets enable_reasoning=0 and default_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false; server-context.cpp derives chat_params.enable_thinking=false
reasoning_mechanism.scope: server-wide default; a request chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking or reasoning_effort would override it per request (server-common.cpp oaicompat_chat_params_parse), so those fields are forbidden in request bodies
reasoning_mechanism.template_effect: the embedded Qwen3.5 template ends the generation prompt with an empty think block ('<think>' newline newline '</think>' newline newline) when enable_thinking is false, instead of an open '<think>' newline; request formatting changes, not only generation behaviour
reasoning_mechanism.token_counter_same_semantics: POST /v1/chat/completions and /v1/chat/completions/input_tokens both call oaicompat_chat_params_parse with the same server chat_params
reasoning_mechanism.environment_precedence: environment variables are applied before command-line arguments; an explicit --reasoning off overrides LLAMA_ARG_REASONING and an enable_thinking from LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS; no LLAMA_ARG_* variable may be present
reasoning_mechanism.live_verification: the gate reads the verified server process command line and requires it to equal the registered launch arguments

context_budget.authoritative_token_counter: frozen llama.cpp b10217 + frozen GGUF + POST /v1/chat/completions/input_tokens
context_budget.token_counter_request_body: the exact inference request body; no projection
context_budget.on_bound_failure: INCONCLUSIVE_CONTEXT_BOUND: the request is not dispatched and the local-9B gate fails; no truncation, summarization, history drop, ceiling change, context increase, prompt change, or retry

gate.structural_evaluator: unchanged calibration evaluator: HTTP 200, terminal non-length content, exact three-key object, code fences rejected
gate.task_turn_note: the frozen h001 no-tool contract terminates on the first response, so the task stage issues one request
gate.after_pass: PREFIXITY_PILOT_CONTEXT_ADEQUACY_REVIEW (offline); the scored pilot is not authorized
gate.replacement_identity: exactly one, only for a genuine pre-inference infrastructure/integrity failure with inference_requests = 0 and no model output; any dispatched request consumes the identity

timeout_policy.supervisor_deadline_derivation: readiness_contacts * readiness_timeout_ms + token_count_contacts * token_count_request_timeout_ms + inference_requests * inference_request_timeout_ms + non_request_margin_ms = 1 * 1000 + 6 * 60000 + 6 * 3540000 + 1200000
timeout_policy.inference_bound_basis: conservative preparation estimate, not a 9B measurement: a full 1024-token response at a slow-session decode rate of about 0.3 tokens/s (0.8B measurements varied about 4x between sessions); kept below the frozen server's default 3600 s read/write timeout
timeout_policy.non_request_margin_basis: measured: debug-build identity hashing of the 9B GGUF took 550943 ms on this host; the margin is about 2x the estimated non-request child work
timeout_policy.per_contact_bounds: each readiness, token-count, and inference contact has its own complete bound
